newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's HPI likely to be listed on Bourse Monday.
newsitem.headline: Italy's HPI likely to be listed on Bourse Monday.

text.p: Shares in Italian industrial holding HPI-Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali SpA, just spun off from financial holding Gemina, will probably be quoted on the Milan bourse from Monday, March 10, Gemina said in a newspaper tombstone.
Gemina this Monday formally signed the deal hiving off its industrial interests. The stock market regulator Consob has already approved HPI's share listing.
The final act before bourse trading can begin is the official listing of the holding in the Milan register of companies, expected to take place on Friday.
